title: GEISA Application Message Response v0.9.0
description: Canonical structure for GEISA application messaging per-request disposition responses aligned to app-message.proto.

request-id.description: Application request identifier used for correlation.

status.description: Upstream only: Platform disposition for the corresponding request-id (for example accepted, rejected, permission-denied, quota-exceeded, unavailable, expired, or other). quota-exceeded means the platform rejected the request because accepting it would exceed an applicable quota or policy limit (for example message-count, byte/volume, or network policy limits). Applications should consult Platform/App Status for detailed usage, remaining quota, and reset timing.

status-text.description: Upstream only: Optional human-readable diagnostic or status text.

timestamp-ms.description: UTC epoch time in milliseconds when the message was created.

geisa-app-message-rsp.$comment: Quota counters/usage values are not carried here; those are reported through Platform/App Status. This response is a per-request disposition, not a metadata echo of the request.
